---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE] <Short description>"
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ''

---

### Description
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. I'm always frustrated when...)

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see. How should it work?

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Benefit to the Project
Why should we prioritize this? How does it help other users?

### Voting & Contribution
- **If you want this feature:** Please leave a 👍 reaction on this issue.
- **If you want to build this:** Please comment "I'd like to work on this" after it reaches [X] votes.

---
**Note:** Features are prioritized based on community interest (👍 reactions) and alignment with the roadmap.
